summary: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd reported a significant surge in sales bookings, reaching Rs 720 crore in the second quarter of this fiscal, a nearly threefold increase from Rs 254 crore in the previous year. title: Prestige Estates Q2 sales bookings jump 50 pc to Rs 6,017 cr on strong housing demand
summary: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd witnessed a remarkable 50% surge in sales bookings, reaching Rs 6,017.3 crore in Q2, fueled by robust housing demand. title: Gold pauses after record rally on safe-haven demand
summary: Gold prices dipped slightly on Thursday after reaching a record high of $4,059.05 the previous day, as investors took profits amidst ongoing economic and geopolitical uncertainties. Hopes for further U.S. interest rate cuts continue to support the precious metal, which has seen significant gains this year due to strong central bank buying and ETF demand.

summary: The dollar strengthened this week, driven by a weakening yen amid political shifts in Japan and ongoing U.S. government shutdown concerns. Federal Reserve minutes suggest caution on future rate cuts.

title: New lending platform to expand credit access, inclusion: RBI Guv Sanjay Malhotra
summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra highlighted the crucial role of the account aggregator framework and the new unified lending interface (ULI) in expanding credit access for the under-served.
